title: Milk brew coffee
creator: morgandrinkscoffee
steps: Put the coffee and milk in a jar (1:13 ratio by weight) and stir until all the coffee is saturated.
Brew in the fridge for 8–10 hours.
Filter through a paper filter (slow; keep it in the fridge while it drips), a cold brew bag or a metal filter.
notes: Any milk and any coffee works. Fruity, natural-process coffees give very different results.
